authority: observations-only; never an input authorizing proof acceptance
specs_digest_encoding: SHA-256 of ordered ASCII compact JSON lines [name,statement,dependencies,script,summary], each followed by LF.
metric_note: Nodes/depth were rechecked by the six actual positive pytest cases. Proof-object counts are observations of this diagnostic, not mathematical invariants.
protected_module_check: Before/after exact keys and object identities for all editions_v modules and the two private loader names; no globally virgin-process assumption.

coverage.test_id_encoding: Each ordered test ID is test_pin.path + '::' + the corresponding case_suffix.
coverage.phase_encoding: For every selected_test_index in each window's listed order, the actual three reports were exactly setup/passed, call/passed, teardown/passed. This losslessly encodes all 996 retained phase records; it is not a proof receipt.

pytest_args: not test_actual_original_ha_body and not test_false_or_incomplete_body_is_rejected and not test_each_removed_dependency_is_rejected and not test_each_poisoned_dependency_is_rejected and not test_fixed_body_rejects_a_removed_input_clause and not test_fixed_body_rejects_false_stronger_output

command_reproduction.substitutions: Replace ARGS_PLACEHOLDER by compact JSON encoding of the window pytest_args and KIND_PLACEHOLDER by that window's exact python_kind_literal. No other template change was made in the four successful windows.

development_observations.correction: Added the genuinely used zero_add prerequisite to row 3; no statement, tactic, kernel, guard, resource limit, or old source changed.

Every declared dependency was separately removed and poisoned; every original input clause was removed in a fixed-body rejection case.
Actual beta-coded natural-sum and residue models are independent finite diagnostics, not proof acceptance.

The old left-unit tail source and every pinned canonical provider/kernel file remained byte-identical.
